summary: Data Scientist with hands-on experience building and shipping computer vision and generative AI systems, plus the data pipelines and cloud infrastructure that support them. I independently built and deployed a switch-state classification model to production on AWS SageMaker/ECR, benchmarked detection/segmentation architectures (YOLO, RT-DETR, Detectron2) for transfer learning, and defined ML scope for a multi-vendor CV engagement. Also hands-on with agentic AI systems (RAG, MCP, LLM tool-use) and LangChain.
